evidence_quotes.O: Hands down, the bokeh is creamy and a total amateur can start taking unbelievable photos with the most mundane type of objects
evidence_quotes.C: I bought this for my D5100 after an exhaustive evaluation of what type of lens I should get to replace my stock 18-55 lens.
evidence_quotes.E: I have this attached to my desktop since I enjoy listening late at night not to disturb anyone.
evidence_quotes.A: I had to learn this the hard way so hopefully this will help someone !
evidence_quotes.N: Seriously, I've been scrounging around for quite some time trying to find a decent security cam package suite and been left in frustration
